skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Gift Uncompleted
skins.content: Beanstalk's personally coordinated casualwear / Gift Uncompleted. An off-white knitted sweater paired with light-green silk pajamas for a low-key aesthetic. When in the company of friends, comfort is the highest priority.
skins.quote: 'Whoever drew the privilege of getting to play with Peacake for a day... Remember to bring them back tomorrow!'

skins.name: Ribbons of Promise
skins.content: Unveiling of Devotion Series New Arrivals/Ribbons of Promise. Dress Beanstalk wore to the holiday party. A trailing dress of pure white is punctuated by a beautiful red, the fluttering ribbons highlighting the girl's vibrant charm.
skins.quote: There are plenty of ribbons for Peacake to play with, but the one actually bound by an eternal vow, she grasps tightly in her hand.
